concept: Cliffside villas in Muscat; villa picker.
palette: rock, white, sea blue, palm green

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of white villas stepped down a cliff above the sea in Muscat, Oman. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: rugged coastal architecture photography, 24mm; colour palette of rock, white, sea blue, palm green. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
